notes.title: Chapter 5 Update and Version 4.33 Now Public!
notes.content:
Yep, everything is now public just under a month after the supporter release. I have removed the chapter 1/5 branch as it is now rolled into the public branch.

A changelog is below, but the gist of it is: New field abilities for chapter 5, a runestone upgrade quest, a new secrebot quest for chapter 5 along with a new form, TF sequence, and even a silly bad end! Oh and an absolute HOST of bugfixes.

//-- [ ========Version 4.29 ========= ]
//--Major
*Added three new field abilities to chapter 5. Darkmatter, Steam Droid, and Electrosprite now all get field abilities.
*Added new emotes (mostly yelling or being smarmy) to Unit 2856's dialogue.
*Added emotes for Agent Almond: ACTION MOTH!
*Fixed the dialogue hang bug for really long cutscenes.
*Added RAM paging for loading files. Should improve stability and decreases memory fragmentation while only increasing load times slightly.

//--Minor
*Added a dialogue topic with 55 about Inhibitor Chips, unlocked when you encounter a latex drone enemy.
*Added a killphrases topic to Christine's terminal so you know what they are even if you don't examine any bodies in Cryogenics.
*Added a topic after the Manufactory quest to discuss what happened with 55.
*Christine's profile will update during the latex drone sequence in sector 99.
*Manufactory noise will now get louder as you get closer to the assembly line.
*Added a new topic with SX-399 about what her name is.
*Added badge to chapter 5 so Darkmatters will leave you alone when equipped.
*Added a number of instances of the PDU appearing during conversations with emotions.
*Updated the start of Regulus City sequence to better flesh out the relationship with Sophie.
*Added some dialogue to the picnic golems in the biolabs movie.
*Added some very angry dialogue to 2856 if you double back after fixing the power modulator in gamma.
*You can now use Electrosprite form to bypass Hydroponics and the Datacore in the Biolabs.
*You can now examine the glass in the amphibian habitat to get clues on the right amphibian for the puzzle!
*SX-399 will now be available in the mines during NC+ after you complete the Sprocket City questline. She only helps out in the mines.
*Pink slimes now have yellow eyes on the sprites.

//--Combat Balance
*Christine's shock-damage abilities are now color coded yellow (some of the electricity was blue) which should read better on the icons. (Thanks, Sigrid!)

//--Bugs
*Fixed music not playing when loading a game.
*Fixed layer tracks reporting errors when loading the game in certain rooms.
*Fixed some offensive equippable items using the wrong strength indicator.
*Fixed gravemarker paragon in the chapter 1 depths not actually triggering a battle when you say yes.
*Fixed two Christines appearing after the first Equinox boss.
*Fixed a missing "local" in Mei's prestige job class.
*Fixed a missing talk sprite in a darkmatter conversation.
*Fixed the Tellurium Mines sometimes generating a 0 XP/JP item and printing a warning.
*Hopefully fixed the non-existant Susan bug.
*Fixed equipment cursor lingering in the empty slot when switching to a character who has fewer equipment slots.
*Fixed invalid nude sprite images in Sprocket City considering the costume is never actually used.
*Haunt should no longer be flagged as a buff.
*Fixed some invalid sprite errors in the post-LRT scene in Christine's quarters.

//-- [ ========Version 4.30 ========= ]
//--Major
//--Minor
*Changed the runestone upgrade quest in chapter 5 to have a description that more clearly specifies that the terminal is NOT in the Cryogenics Facility.
*You can now talk to the dancing raiju in the biolabs.
*Maps will now correctly recenter when entering them if using the white PDU dot.
*Removed constant light re-upload since the bugs it fixed should hopefully be fixed now.
*Modified "Primastic Shield" to correctly show a simplified description.
*Added voice lines for Chris, voiced by Pyxxis!

//--Combat Balance
*Lowered cooldowns on field abilities in chapter 5.

//--Bugs
*Typos
*Secrebot form should persist into NC+.
*Full-Auto should no longer generate a free CP pip.
*Fixed an error in Dr. Maisie's scripts.
*Fixed golem TF not playing and just skipping to the next part.
*Fixed editing a save's note causing it to wreck the savefile.
*55's Focus Fire now has a 3-turn cooldown, 3-turn duration, and generates no CP.
*The raiju you can talk to near the ladder in Sector 96 will now turn to face you.
*Can no longer talk to the intercom in Sector 96 from the other side of the wall (It's called a radio interface, people! We're robots!)
*Christine's dropped stuff during the secrebot quest will no longer render in front of the player.
*Fixed a blackout error in the secrebot quest maps.
*Fixed a misaligned portrait for Secrebot Christine.
*Fixed Christine facing the wrong way during one of the secrebot cutscenes.
*Fixed an error in SX-399's dialogue scripts.
*Fixed "Impromptu Organization" lasting an extra turn when used on Christine, and not having a "Fast" in its description.
*Fixed "Forced Rescheduling" inflicting the wrong damage type.
*Fixed Manufactory work terminal entry not appearing.
*Fixed SX-399's "Improvise" overrunning the edge of the text box.
*Fixed a missing collision in the Hydroponics labs.
*Fixed the wrong music switching if the player is going to the gala and approaches the trainer area.
*Added secrebot dialogue for Sophie.
*Added flags for Sophie to gain knowledge of the runestone after the secrebot quest if she didn't already have it (this will not retroactively apply to savefiles so the dialogue may be odd)
*Changed Christine's crouch/wounded frames for secrebot.
*Fixed empty dialogue box during intro to secrebot quest.
*Work terminal will now only remind you of the secrebot quest until you actually talk to Sophie and fix the secrebot.
*Fixed wrong talk sprites appearing during sprocket city introduction.
*Recalibrated RegulusCryoLowerD's map positions.
*IN-12 will now check the SX-399 upgrade quest instead of Christine having Steam Droid form (so she will respond correctly in NC+)
*Fixed error in IN-12 responding to Christine's form (it was "Secrebots" instead of "Secrebot")
*Christine can no longer trigger a "Bounceback" counter-attack on a target 55 killed with "Covering Fire".
*Fixed Gravemarker paragon showing the red robe wounded pose when defeated.
*Fixed fictitious catalyst counts due to NC+ shenanigans. Catalyst counts should be much more robust in general now.
*Fixed chapter 1 quests printing error messages if they haven't been discovered yet.

//-- [ ========Version 4.31 ========= ]
//--Major
*Defeat handling is now considerably more robust and party members who revert to human will now re-transform at the save point!
*Added some new art to the secrebot "bad end".
*Secrebot TF and Bad End now have relive handlers.

//--Minor
*Voice line volumes normalized.
*Updated biolabs runestone topic to handle the runestone upgrade quest.
*Added a platinum compass on-screen indicator next to the stamina bar. This allows hard of hearing players to still know if there's a catalyst nearby.
*Improved memory handling code, should be even fewer memory leaks!
*Removed "Save audio volumes in savefile" option since nobody uses it and it's confusing.
*Removed some other options that aren't used anymore.
*Accessory and item types will now say "Chris" instead of "Christine" during the first part of chapter 5, and dynamically change after completing Cryogenics.
*Night now has a profile in the journal.
*You can now talk with Night a bit more when on a date with Sophie.
*Slightly changed dialogue in the secrebot quest if you've done the Cassandra quest.
*Improved memory handling, bitmaps should unload during level transition to avoid stutter.
*Badges are now marked as Badges instead of Accessories.

//--Combat Balance
*Added Prestige passives for Christine and SX-399. Sorry, 55, but your effortless class-switching means you don't get class prestige passives!

//--Bugs
*Fixed incorrect skill catalyst count on loading game.
*Fixed skills being left on Chris' skillbar in NC+ because his default job has no skills. Teachers have no skills!
*Fixed Electrosprite not having Fry on its class skillbar.
*Fixed defeat scene in Cryogenics using the golem Christine line in NC+.
*Fixed two of SX-399's voice clips playing all four takes instead of just one.
*Fixed missing dialogue for the red keycard in the biolabs datacore.
*Adjusted the work terminal dialogue during the first date with Sophie.
*Fixed music not playing during the running minigame in chapter 5.
*Added some sound effects for getting shocked.
*The "Defaults" option now resets character voice volumes to 50% instead of increasing them by 50%.
*Fixed missing collisions on the airlock in the western LRT facility.
*Adjusted a very minor bit of dialogue to further denigrate Talos.
*Fixed an incorrect blackout in one scene in the LRT facility.
*Can no longer use Christine's field abilities when she's not in the party during the Raibie quest.
*Fixed incorrect dialogues after completing the raibie quest but before leaving the ranch.
*Fixed wrong dialogue appearing if you steal the free stuff in sector 254 after Christine is a fixed secrebot.
*Fixed incorrect dialogue on the power exchanger in Cryogenics in NC+.
*Master Prowler will now show the correct attack power boost on the GUI.

//-- [ ========Version 4.32 ========= ]
//--Major
//--Minor
*Added Zombee Queen costume (Thanks, Xandra!). It's unlocked same as bee queen and works when you're a zombee, duh.
*For convenience, 55 will now appear from the vents when checking the runestone upgrade console so you don't have to go to the 2nd floor just to bring her back.
*Getting the gravemarker TF scene will now toggle on the runestone quest flag in the journal so you know to ask her about it.
*Trainer UI will now show level-ups if the amount of XP purchased causes one.
*Added Sanya profile entries for bunny/harpy form.
*Added higher-quality Zombee portraits. Thanks to Xandra for fixing the (thought to be lost!) original files up.

//--Combat Balance
*Added "Unstunnable" and "Unpredictable" buffs. These make it a bit more clear in the combat inspector when an enemy cannot be stunned or ignores threat.
*Adjusted Florentina's Mushraune stats to differentiate them from Merchant.

//--Bugs
*Fixed being able to activate the wisphag TF whirlpool during the rubber sequence.
*Hopefully fixed catalysts not counting on loading game FOR THE LAST TIME.
*Fixed Zombees spawning in the beehive basement if you just got the Zombee scene from transforming during the boss fight.
*Fixed always resetting volumes to 0.75 when returning to the title screen.
*Removed some diagnostic text.
*Fixed Secrebot not handled by the golem in the ExteriorEA tram station.
*Fixed Trainer UI not crossfading correctly on the spend/confirm windows (WHY DID NONE OF YOU REPORT THIS???)
*Fixed extra empty textbox at end of bunny TF in chapter 2.
*Fixed incorrect flag being set when turning in bunny quest pamphlet.
*It should no longer be possible to lure the goose far enough that you don't need to see the hunting tutorial prompt in chapter 2.
*Fixed being unable to open the map in the warrens cave after getting Angelface to meet you there.
*It should no longer be possible to talk to Marigold from behind by giving the springwater and then walking all the way around Fort Kirysu.
*Updated Cave Crawler turn portrait to use the correct image.
*Fixed a bunch of mixing pixels on the Izuna carried sprites.
*Sanya's Flank Tactics now costs the usual passive JP.
*Fixed some erroneous tiles in NorthwoodsSCB.
*Fixed warping giving an erroneous message at the very start of chapter 2.
*Fixed wisphags not having sprites or a combat portrait in chapter 2.
*Empress' Move Move! description fixed to correctly show it increased Evade and Initiative.
*Zeke's Nuzzle prediction fixed to show 1 turn and not 3 turn duration.
*Fixed diagnostic text rendering for Close Assault.
*Fixed Close Assault only providing one instance of stun if multiple attacks crit.

//-- [ ========Version 4.33 ========= ]
//--Major
//--Minor
*Added finalized Sanya Sevavi combat portraits!
*55 now has idle animations.

//--Combat Balance
//--Bugs
*Fixed fnCutsceneInstruction() being lost due to a find-replace mistake.
*Fixed several memory issues (Thanks, Valgrind!)

notes.title: Mines Patch
notes.content: This patch fixes a typo in the mines difficulty script, allowing the rarely seen "Mad" enemies to spawn.

notes.title: Patch v4.00 Released
notes.content:
This patch is a bugfix patch since several more bugs were fixed incidentally while we were working on chapter 2. This release is also compatible with the chapter 2 intro, which will be released on May 2nd.

If you would like to play chapter 2's intro, you can [url=https://www.patreon.com/Saltyjustice]join our patreon here[/url] (any pledge is enough!). On May 2nd, a password for the beta will be released. The location is specified in the pinned patron post.

[ ========Version 4.00 ========= ]
Major
*Chapter 2's introduction is now playable. No kidding.
*Fixed that damn inventory load crash bug. This should be under the Bugs heading but it took so much work to find it that I'm putting it in the major tab.
*Go ahead, try to do something about it.

Minor
*Refactored the combat execution code.
*Added some new indicators for buffs so you can tell at-a-glance what stats got buffed/debuffed.
*Mei's Queen Bee costume now shows up in the journal and on the costume select menu.
*The UI should now immediately reflect stat changes when passives are equipped.

Combat Balance
*Fixed Christine's discharge not correctly changing damage types based on the weapon secondary.
*Added a distinction in the prediction box. The game will warn you when an attack can only Glance versus a guaranteed miss.
*609144 can now be stunned.
*Effects modified in battle by a severity (such as 55's User Manuals) now show the computed effect value in the combat inspector, instead of the base value.
*Added a few more gem slots to common low-level armors to allow a bit more early customization.

Bugs
*Buyback no longer carries over when loading the game or changing chapters.
*Fixed a number of small bugs involving the combat engine.
*Latex Drones now show the "Volunteer" icon if you don't have the form yet.
*Fixed some incorrect combat item descriptions.
*Fixed a specific box in the LRT facility that was not clipped, and causing much consternation.
*Fixed the missing icon for the GOV Gem.

notes.title: Version 3.59 Released
notes.content:
Full changelog below. This patch should hopefully fix the issue with local achievements not saving between sessions for some Steam users. Please let me know if this one fixes it.
This version (steam only, standalone users are not affected) will create a second achievements savefile in your C:\Users\appdata\local\ folder. Should prevent Steam from overwriting it.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[b]Minor[/b]
*You can now hide ability descriptions entirely with F2, in addition to toggling simple/complex versions.
*Added a flag (for modders) called "Run Frames" to force an NPC to load running frames on creation.

[b]Combat Balance[/b]
*Added Black Site paragon grouping for chapter 5.

[b]Bugs[/b]
*Fixed the chapter 5 Cassandra achievement not unlocking if using the south door to talk to her.
*Fixed Raiju Christine's Battery Drainer ability not existing.
*Fixed item drops failing in some cases.
*Fixed getting multiple drops of the same name not rewarding the item multiple times.
*Fixed positive/negative charges not building in combat.
*Fixed missing downed sprites for some paragons.
*Fixed inventory not showing quantity correctly for stackable items.
*Fixed Chain Zap not hitting multiple targets.
*Fixed some missing collisions in the Tellurium Mines.
*Fixed a text overrun in 609144's profile.

notes.title: Patch v3.57a
notes.content: Fixed an error related to topics causing them to not fire correctly.

notes.title: Patch v3.57
notes.content:
Added a bunch more Candle Haunts to make getting those paragons easier.
Fixed the SDL filesystem.
Added a lot of backend to handle mod support. Workshop support will come... someday.

notes.title: Patch v3.56
notes.content:
*Fixed rilmani dresses showing transparent pixels.
*Fixed Steam achievements not unlocking in the Steam API immediately. If you got any achievements, they are stored locally and should unlock when you next start the game.
*Removed some debug text.
